intro.zh: 暖白阅读底色、衬线标题、左侧学习目标栏，配绿色与橙色标记；适合课程讲授、技术培训和带练习的教学单元。
intro.en: Warm off-white reading pages, serif headings and a learning-objective rail with green and orange markers; for lessons, technical training and units with exercises.
intro.ja: 温かいオフホワイトの紙面、セリフ体見出し、学習目標レール、緑とオレンジのマーカー。授業や技術研修向け。

routing.avoid: Executive pitches or brand launches that need large display statements.

pageMapping.differences: Source is a full-width page: kicker, large serif title with an italic phrase, description, three mono tag chips and a footer line; native adds a tinted left band with an orange rule, puts the title to its right and has no italic emphasis or chips.

Source rail is a narrow text column (course mark, five objectives with progress dots, module progress) split off by a hairline, and the main area holds four numbered white cards; native rail is a tinted box with an orange top rule holding one objective sentence, and the main area is a plain bullet list.

Source main area has an intro paragraph, a rule-of-thumb callout with an orange bar and two white cards with inline code chips beside the progress rail; the native lesson page has a single-objective tinted rail and a plain bullet list.

Source keeps the objective rail beside a dark code block with syntax colours and a trace callout below; the native code page has no rail, a full-width dark-green code block in one text colour and no callout.

Source shows the exercise as an orange-tinted bordered box with a numbered task list, a hint line and a time note in the rail; the native lesson page has a single-objective rail and a plain bullet list, no exercise box or numbering.

Source is a knowledge check: three lettered answer rows with the correct one highlighted green and an explanation; the native lesson page shows a plain bullet list with no answer rows or highlighted answer.

Source is a full-width summary: large serif title, a 2 x 2 grid of white check-marked cards and an up-next callout; native is a content title with an orange marker and one row of three square tinted cards with a top bar, no check marks or callout.
